newsitem.title: USA: Total Petroleum says no deal proposal.
newsitem.headline: Total Petroleum says no deal proposal.

text.p: Total Petroleum (North America) Ltd has been exploring strategic alliances in refining and marketing but has not yet come to any decision, the company said in a statement.
"To date, no alliance has been proposed that adds value beyond what the company believes it can accomplish through its own internal improvement program," Total Petroleum said.

Total SA, the company's French parent which owns 55 percent of Total Petroleum's stock, was reported to be in talks to sell its U.S. refining and marketing operations which comprise Total Petroleum to Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp for $400 million plus $430 million of debt.
Ultramar Diamond said earlier that it had held talks with Total but no deal had been agreed. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
